svg.text: Late writes from a lost rank
One receiver's dispatch workspace; each cell is a token row, numbered by the source rank that writes it
aimed at rank 2's row in step n,
lands in rank 3's row in step n+1
stays in rank 2's own region, never read again
Separate arrays, each with one slot per source rank: rank 2's late writes only reach slot 2 of each.
Only the payload layout is new; the counters, flags and EPLB stats already had one fixed slot per source on main.
